title: CI: Auto-cancel redundant pipelines
body:
This is a suggestion cut out from !3680.

As described in ttps://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/#workflowauto_cancelon_new_commit, this change hopefully enables auto-cancellation of redundant pipelines, e.g., when new commits are pushed to an existing branch.
This may be helpful particularly for contributors using their forked repos to save their pipeline time.

author: yuzie007

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Thank you @yuzie007, that's a good idea.  I actually thought that we had automatic cancellation of pipelines at some point, but maybe something changed.

Merging.
